active_goal: Initialize ChatGPT Project alignment sources for MeatHarness.

tasks.title: Use project instructions as operating charter
acceptance_criteria: Assistant inspects repo files before making repo-specific claims.

decisions.summary: Use a static JSON source as the execution layer and replace its contents after substantial work turns.
decisions.rationale: ChatGPT Project Sources are not automatically mutable during a chat turn, so the assistant must provide an updated replacement JSON object when state changes.

assumptions.summary: The assistant has access to the connected GitHub repo when repo-specific work is requested.
assumptions.risk: If connector access is unavailable, the user must paste/upload files or reconnect the repo.

verified_facts.summary: The repo is `DigitalHerencia/MeatHarness` and is a private GitHub repository.
The repo contains TypeScript/Ink-oriented anchors including `src/cli.ts`, `src/app.tsx`, state files, component screens, utilities, `package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, and `.agent-logs/events.jsonl`.

notes: Read `package.json` before naming exact validation scripts.

next_actions.summary: Upload these files as ChatGPT Project Sources and paste `PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS.md` into the Project Instructions field.
On first repo-work turn, inspect `package.json`, `src/cli.ts`, `src/app.tsx`, and `src/state/useMeatHarnessController.ts`.
